svg.title: SLSA & Build Provenance Attestations Architecture
svg.desc: SLSA diagram showing SLSA v1.2 Build track levels (L0 to L3), in-toto provenance JSON schema, and hermetic build isolation.
svg.text: SLSA & Build Provenance Attestations
SLSA v1.2 Build Levels (L0–L3), in-toto provenance statements, and verifiable build platform isolation.
SLSA V1.2 BUILD TRACK LEVELS
Graduated Build Integrity Guarantees
• L0: No integrity guarantees
• L1: Provenance exists & distributed (documents build process)
• L2: Authentic verifiable provenance + hosted build platform
• L3: Dedicated builder isolation (hardened ephemeral build steps)
IN-TOTO PROVENANCE SCHEMA
Verifiable Build Attestation Predicate
• Builder ID: Identifies the hosted build service URI
• BuildType: Identifies workflow template & entrypoint script
• External Parameters & Resolved Dependencies (git commit hash)
• Subject: Cryptographic hash (SHA-256) of output binary artifact
PROVENANCE VERIFICATION & REPRODUCIBLE BUILDS
Cryptographic Verification vs Source Code Auditing
• Verification Policy: SLSA verifier matches artifact hash against signed provenance from trusted builder ID
• Hermetic Builds: Network-isolated build steps pulling only declared dependencies from verified local caches
• Security Limit: SLSA proves *how* an artifact was built; it does NOT prove that source code or dependencies were benign.
SLSA INTEGRITY FLOW: SOURCE COMMIT → HOSTED BUILDER → SIGNED IN-TOTO ATTESTATION → VERIFIER VALIDATION
